name: std-file-store
description: std-file-store — the generic file/page tree primitive. A file-tree + config-driven data table over a hierarchical collection; opens a row in `viewing_single` with config-driven detail actions. Rebindable: pass `fields`/`itemActions`/`detailActions`/`tree` to retarget it at any hierarchical entity (files, wiki pages, note trees). Folds in the former std-page-tree via `reorderable` + a page field/action set.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The file's display name or title.

fields.name: path
fields.description: The location of the file within the storage system.

fields.name: mimeType
fields.description: The file's content type, indicating its format.

fields.name: uploaderId
fields.description: Identifier of the user who uploaded the file.

fields.name: uploaderName
fields.description: The name of the user who uploaded the file.

fields.name: folder
fields.description: The path to the containing directory.

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp indicating when the file was uploaded.
fields.synonyms: upload date, date uploaded, upload time

fields.name: isArchived
fields.description: Indicates whether the file is archived.
